opencode-go.guidance: Supports Go and Go Plus. Obtain your API key from OpenCode Console.
opencode-go.storage: Your API key is stored securely on the selected server. Connecting stores the key; it does not verify subscription entitlement.
opencode-go.unsupported: This server does not support OpenCode Go connections.
opencode-go.disconnectGuidance: Disconnecting cancels active account requests and removes its protected key. Existing session history remains.
opencode-go.title: Connect OpenCode Go
